procedure: After human confirmation that the browser holder closed, create a fresh owned UHID with caller EEPROM and imported synthetic MP/Nunchuk resources. Revalidate HID association and raw linkage after human grants. Run MP then MP+Nunchuk, each 35 seconds with an isolated native Wiimote profile, exact owned raw endpoint, SDL Wii disabled and process-only radio guard. Require no companion holder before each consumer; runner opens none. Capture native I/O, compare successful calibration payloads privately to caller blocks, terminate owned children between profiles, close producer idempotently and verify HID/raw/LED removal. No ROM/game or Real slot.
semantic_outcome: Clean no-holder Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 native Wiimote motionplus-nunchuk comparison with caller EEPROM and synthetic imported MP/Nunchuk calibration passes the base EEPROM read. All 18 native A40020/16 reads succeed: 17 returned payloads match the caller Nunchuk block and one matches the MP block first half. Native identity observations include Nunchuk before the first calibration request; concurrent kernel mapping can change the addressed device, so reply counts are not a sole-actor interpretation oracle. Repeated initialization/report-mode activity continues. Decoded application motion remains unobserved; no physical calibration, accurate rate, whole-controller or wrong-bank-defect claim follows. No companion event holder exists at each arm preflight and the runner opens none; this does not unbind the kernel driver or isolate its protocol output.
